Canvas starts after row6 all6? Input rows: 0-2 top, row3 all7, row4 legend, row5 all7, row6 all6. Then row7-19 = 13 rows. Output size 13x11. Background 7. For each marker in canvas (rows7-19), draw 3x3 square of mapped color centered at marker coordinate (canvas row = input row -7). Need handle edge clipping? Check centers positions.

List canvas rows 7..19 with index r=0..12:
r0 (input7): all 7
r1 (8): all 7
r2 (9): [7,8,7,7,7,7,8,7,7,8,7] -> markers 8 at c1, c6, c9.
r3 (10): all7
r4 (11): all7
r5 (12): [7,3,7,7,7,7,7,2,7,7,7] -> 3 at c1, 2 at c7.
r6 (13): [7,7,7,7,3,7,7,7,7,7,7] -> 3 at c4.
r7 (14): all7
r8 (15): all7
r9 (16): [7,7,8,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7] -> 8 at c2.
r10 (17): [7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,8,7] -> 8 at c9.
r11 (18): [7,7,7,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,7] -> 2 at c6.
r12 (19): all7.

Mapping:
8 -> 9
3 -> 5
2 -> 6

Draw 3x3 centered at each marker (r,c), covering rows r-1..r+1, cols c-1..c+1. Clip to grid 0..12, 0..10.

Let's list markers:
A: r2,c1 val8 -> color9. Cover rows1-3, cols0-2 (c0-2). Since c=1, cols0,1,2.
B: r2,c6 val8 -> color9. Cover rows1-3, cols5-7.
C: r2,c9 val8 -> color9. Cover rows1-3, cols8-10.
D: r5,c1 val3 -> color5. Cover rows4-6, cols0-2.
E: r5,c7 val2 -> color6. Cover rows4-6, cols6-8.
F: r6,c4 val3 -> color5. Cover rows5-7, cols3-5.
G: r9,c2 val8 -> color9. Cover rows8-10, cols1-3.
H: r10,c9 val8 -> color9. Cover rows9-11, cols8-10.
I: r11,c6 val2 -> color6. Cover rows10-12, cols5-7.

Need compose 13x11 all 7 then fill. Check overlaps? A/B/C at row1-3 maybe no overlap because cols sets 0-2,5-7,8-10. B and C separated? B cols5-7, C cols8-10 adjacent no overlap. D cols0-2 rows4-6. E cols6-8 rows4-6. F cols3-5 rows5-7. G cols1-3 rows8-10. H cols8-10 rows9-11. I cols5-7 rows10-12. Check overlap G and F? F rows5-7, G rows8-10, no. H and I? H cols8-10 rows9-11, I cols5-7 rows10-12, no. D and F? D rows4-6 cols0-2, F rows5-7 cols3-5, no. E and F? E rows4-6 cols6-8, F rows5-7 cols3-5, no. E and I? E rows4-6, I rows10-12 no. So simple.

Now build rows 0..12 length 11.

Initialize all 7.

Row0: no coverage? A rows1-3. So row0 all 7. length 11.

Row1: A covers cols0-2=9. B cols5-7=9. C cols8-10=9. Others no. Row1: c0 9, c1 9, c2 9, c3 7, c4 7, c5 9, c6 9, c7 9, c8 9, c9 9, c10 9.
Wait C covers cols8-10=9. So c5-c10: c5-7 B, c8-10 C => c5-10 all 9. Row1 = [9,9,9,7,7,9,9,9,9,9,9].

Row2: A rows1-3 includes row2 cols0-2=9. B cols5-7=9. C cols8-10=9. Row2 same as row1: [9,9,9,7,7,9,9,9,9,9,9].

Row3: A rows1-3 includes row3 cols0-2=9. B cols5-7=9. C cols8-10=9. Row3 same.

Row4: D covers rows4-6 cols0-2=5. E covers rows4-6 cols6-8=6. Any A? A rows1-3 no. So row4: c0-2=5, c3=7,c4=7,c5=7, c6-8=6, c9=7,c10=7.
Row4 = [5,5,5,7,7,7,6,6,6,7,7].

Row5: D cols0-2=5. E cols6-8=6. F covers rows5-7 cols3-5=5. So c0-2=5, c3-5=5, c6-8=6. c9-10=7. Row5 = [5,5,5,5,5,5,6,6,6,7,7]? Wait c0-5 all 5 (D c0-2, F c3-5), c6-8 6, c9,c10 7. Yes.

Row6: D rows4-6 cols0-2=5. E rows4-6 cols6-8=6. F rows5-7 cols3-5=5. So c0-5 =5, c6-8=6, c9-10=7. Row6 same as row5? D at row6 yes, E yes, F yes. Row6 = [5,5,5,5,5,5,6,6,6,7,7].

Row7: F covers rows5-7 cols3-5=5. D/E end row6. So c0-2=7, c3-5=5, c6-10=7. Row7 = [7,7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7,7,7].

Row8: G covers rows8-10 cols1-3=9. No others? F row7 ends. So c0=7, c1-3=9, c4-10=7. Row8 = [7,9,9,9,7,7,7,7,7,7,7].

Row9: G rows8-10 cols1-3=9. H covers rows9-11 cols8-10=9. Row9: c0=7, c1-3=9, c4-7=7, c8-10=9. Row9 = [7,9,9,9,7,7,7,7,9,9,9].

Row10: G rows8-10 cols1-3=9. H rows9-11 cols8-10=9. I rows10-12 cols5-7=6. Row10: c0=7, c1-3=9, c4=7, c5-7=6, c8-10=9. Row10 = [7,9,9,9,7,6,6,6,9,9,9].

Row11: G ends row10. H rows9-11 cols8-10=9. I rows10-12 cols5-7=6. Row11: c0-4=7, c5-7=6, c8-10=9. Row11 = [7,7,7,7,7,6,6,6,9,9,9].

Row12: I rows10-12 cols5-7=6. H ends row11. Row12: c0-4=7, c5-7=6, c8-10=7. Row12 = [7,7,7,7,7,6,6,6,7,7,7].

Check output dimensions 13x11. Need ensure mapping: legend markers at c1=3, c5=8, c9=2 under top blocks: c1 corresponds block color 5, c5 corresponds 9, c9 corresponds 6. So 3->5, 8->9, 2->6. Yes.

Now submit_prediction with grid.
